findings.evidence: Existing replacements: Action/Convolution/Algebra.lean:112 defines ConvolutionAlgebra with the same C_c carrier; Normed.lean:52,92,119,148 provides toL1, toL1LI, toL1_injective, norm_star; Multiplier.lean:103,125,129,148,154,169 provides translateLIE and its laws/continuity. The new trivialComplexEquiv explicitly identifies the products, stars, norms, and translations.
findings.fix: Use ConvolutionAlgebra (CStarAction.trivial (G := G) (A := ℂ)) μ as the underlying algebra and reuse its instances, toL1, toL1LI, toL1_injective, norm_star, translateLIE, translation laws, and continuity theorem; retain the new universal group seminorm development on that algebra.
findings.issue: GroupConvolutionAlgebra independently rebuilds ConvolutionAlgebra specialized to CStarAction.trivial: the Basic, Mul, Star, Normed, and Translate sections duplicate existing constructions and expose interchangeable APIs requiring trivialComplexEquiv.

summary: The group convolution algebra introduces a parallel implementation of the existing trivial-action convolution algebra, duplicating its algebraic, norm, and translation APIs.
